pages.text: $(li)Use an $(o)Essentia$() ME storage bus—not a generic Item Storage Bus—to connect essentia to ME systems.$(li)Keep essentia on a dedicated subnet (not the main ME network) to avoid cache issues and lag.

$(li)Use Storage Level Emitters (not Essentia-specific emitters) to monitor essentia levels in ME drives.$(li)Configurable Essentia Cells reduce clutter: one cell handles multiple essentia types instead of one per type.

$(li)Import/Export Interfaces can store essentia indefinitely, acting as infinite-capacity storage and bypassing the need for Essentia Cells in some setups.$(li)Essentia import/export buses are always filtered—you must manually set the essentia type in the bus GUI;
they do not auto-pull any available essentia.

$(li)To automate the Thaumatorium, use Essentia Export Interfaces (not Infusion Providers) to feed essentia; Infusion Providers only work with the Runic Matrix.$(li)Essentia output hatches behave like jars—you can attach storage buses to them for ME integration.

$(li)For wireless essentia export without filtering, use wireless essentia + an Emptying Essentia Transfuser to pull from jars within 16 blocks.$(li)Avoid using essentia storage buses on essentia providers—they cause cache-update issues and lag; use import/export buses instead.
$(li)Thaumcraft tubes are unreliable and prone to jamming (visible as gas leaks and Flux generation); avoid overloading or unbalanced flow.

$(li)Essentia types do not appear alphabetically in JEI, so manual filtering or slot-based automation is required to avoid errors when managing many essentia types.$(li)Essentia Mirrors have EMC and are easy to craft, but transform part of your essentia into Flux—use cautiously.

$(li)A 4+1 nutrient cycle (4 nutrient + 1 empty slot) reduces nutrient consumption from 10% to 5% per cycle in crystallizers.$(li)To connect ME cables to Compact Machines, use a ME Capability Adapter—it fetches sides automatically and is not side-specific.
$(li)You can smelt essentia on-site for machines using a subnet’s wireless essentia or export buses—no need to bring essentia to the main network.
